evals.prompt: Design the architecture for a seed-stage startup building an e-commerce platform with 3 developers.
evals.expected_output: The agent recommends a modular monolith with PostgreSQL to avoid over-engineering, generating an ADR.
expectations: The agent selects a modular monolith architecture instead of premature microservices
An ADR is generated following the standard template in docs/adr/
Ops complexity and team size are explicitly cited as trade-off rationale

evals.prompt: Evaluate architecture trade-offs between serverless vs microservices for an event-driven telemetry ingest pipeline.
evals.expected_output: The agent scores both options using the decision matrix and outputs an ADR recommending serverless event processing.
expectations: Architectural decision matrix is evaluated with detailed rationale
An ADR is output documenting trade-offs
